sentences.ar: بعد شهور، وصلني مكتوب من تريلوني.
sentences.en: After months, a letter reached me from Trelawney.
He wrote: the ship is ready, come quickly.

sentences.ar: ودعت أمي وأنا حزين ومبسوط بنفس الوقت.
sentences.en: I said goodbye to my mother, sad and happy at once.

sentences.ar: كانت أول مرة بطلع من البلد.
sentences.en: It was the first time I had left the town.
Bristol was full of ships and sailors.
I stood at the harbour hardly believing it.
